description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Able to use mandragora spell-like abilities, character level 11, paragon mandragoran, malboro kin racial trait, mandragora

Benefit: You may use Bad Breath as a spell-like ability up to 3 times per day. In addition, you gain another use of Dream Pollen and Photosynthesis per day. Your caster level is equal to your character level.
